text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the middle of town, I spotted Duramente 
looking noticeably disheartened with 
slumped shoulders.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ............ I cannot find it...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Duramente's "WORR"... Initiating... 
"contact".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Duramente... undergoing 『distress』?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Universe. Well... truthfully, the eg—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ..."TAMA"?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...No. It is nothing. This is a problem I 
must resolve on my own.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
..."TAMA". A "task" that must be resolved 
by oneself.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Neo Universe "analyzes"―― 
............"UNDY".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Duramente's intended "heading" is... Over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Ah... Where are we going?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Feeling somewhat uneasy watching from 
afar, I decided to accompany them.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Look... "TAMA". Acquisition by one's own 
power is "possible".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Would you like to try... a "tractor beam" 
with Neo Universe?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Very well, let us try.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...While this is not what I sought, 
conquering the game brought a certain 
sense of fulfillment.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Whether they were truly understanding 
each other remained a mystery. Yet an 
oddly harmonious atmosphere surrounded the 
two as they spent time together――

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Hah!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"TAMA"... Stone "projection range" 
increased. "Maneuvering technique" from 
hand to shoulder... elevated.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Next... wish to "lift off" with Neo 
Universe? To see which one can fly 
further...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. I will not lose.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Before I knew it, dusk has fallen. Time 
passed remarkably fast today.
choice_data_list: Were you able to achieve your goal?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...No, I did not. However, as this remains 
my own personal challenge――

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Duramente. Is the targeted 
"destination"――this?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
This is... 『Anyone Can Do It One-Handed: 
The Complete Guide to Cracking Eggs』...!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...To think you actually arrived at the 
answer...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: ..."WORR" resolved. Mission complete.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Somehow or another, it seems their 
intentions were properly communicated to 
each other—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Forgive me, Universe. To be honest—I 
had my doubts.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Where on earth were you trying to take me? 
What were you possibly thinking? ...I 
wondered.
choice_data_list: ...You weren't on the same page at all?!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't bring myself to reveal it. 
...That I was struggling with something as 
simple as cracking an egg, and went so far 
as to seek a solution elsewhere.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Even so, you... stood by me, thought it 
through— and in the end, reached the 
answer.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...You truly are a wondrous person, 
Universe.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Sphera. Because Duramente responded to the 
"signal"... we were able to reach the 
"singularity".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Neo Universe is "COMF". "Connect" with 
Duramente is good.
choice_data_list: You had some good "communion", didn't you?

I'd like to hear what you both thought of 
the trip.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
...Neo Universe is "COMF". "Connect" with 
Duramente is good.
choice_data_list: You had some good "communion", didn't you?

I'd like to hear what you both thought of 
the trip.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Time like this is nice once in a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
To put it in your terms, Universe... 
"SISR". It was a good day.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If I were to "verbalize"... today's fun... 
it's the strongest... right.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...It was enjoyable, however.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe's status is... "SISR". 
Awaiting... another "singularity".
